text.content: Purgatory is @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.city-npcs.Actor.23221c2030364a34]{Bjorn Garinson}'s @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah}-run nightclub in Adams-Morgan, the unofficial social hub for Washington's leaderless @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} and a haven for hedonistic excess. The Prince quietly tolerates — even encourages — the violence that flares in the surrounding neighborhood, treating it as a useful pressure valve and feeding ground where Masquerade breaches are unlikely to draw outside attention. Bjorn keeps a battle-ax in the club's back room, reserved in his imagination for the night he finally moves against Marcus Vitel.

The Octagon House serves as the seat of the Washington @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} Chantry and one of Pontifex Peter Dorfman's primary havens, housing some of the finest political minds the clan has to offer alongside vast occult libraries and artifact collections. Despite its unified public face, the Chantry is riven by private rivalries — between Dorfman and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.city-npcs.Actor.dcfa8076e00843c2]{Regent Helena Taylor}, between Colin Rose and Pieter Van Dorn, and around the hidden corruption quietly spreading from Dr. Hans Schmidt's secret Dark Thaumaturgy.

Hidden along a forest dirt road between Washington and Annapolis, Castle Adams is the gothic, gargoyle-crowned fortress of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} elder Dorian Adams. Behind its theatrical exterior lies a genuinely lethal maze of secret corridors, cutting-edge security systems, and magical traps built by a paranoid vampire with centuries of practice; a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} raiding party that stormed the castle was never seen again. Washington's elders generally decline Dorian's frequent invitations to visit.

The Black Magic is Wayland Smith's stage-magic-themed nightclub in Georgetown, financed by mortal investors and staffed in part by his ghoul partner Raphael. It was here that Wayland first met Angelique Stravinsky on opening night, an encounter that ended with his Embrace after a near-fatal anarch attack outside the club.

Nominally a psychiatric hospital treating an unusual clientele of ex-CIA agents, disgraced bureaucrats, and politicians, the Bethesda Institute is secretly controlled by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} Dr. Jeffrey Granger, who Dominates its Dominated-ghoul director, Dr. Joshua Lyons, to keep his true nature hidden. The Institute's patient population and staff make it a rich, if psychologically hazardous, hunting and information-gathering ground.

vtmlarp.source: DC by Night, Chapters Three & Four
